There were 44 participating teams.{{cite web|url=https://img.legaseriea.it/vimages/6654a871/253%20-%20Regolamento%20Coppa%20Italia%20Frecciarossa%202024-2027.pdf|title=Coppa Italia: Regolamento|publisher=Lega Serie A|language=it|access-date=19 August 2025|date=27 May 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250903230346/https://img.legaseriea.it/vimages/6654a871/253%20-%20Regolamento%20Coppa%20Italia%20Frecciarossa%202024-2027.pdf|archive-date=3 September 2025|url-status=dead}} [[Bologna FC 1909|Bologna]] were the defending champions, having won their third title in the [[2024–25 Coppa Italia|previous edition]] after defeating [[AC Milan]] 1–0 in the [[2025 Coppa Italia final|final]].{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/clyglj8evzgt|title=AC Milan 0–1 Bologna: Bologna win Coppa Italia to end 51-year trophy drought|publisher=BBC Sport|date=14 May 2025|access-date=14 May 2025}} They were eliminated by [[SS Lazio|Lazio]] in the quarter-finals. [[Inter Milan]] won its tenth Coppa Italia, defeating Lazio 2–0 in the [[2026 Coppa Italia final|final]]. ==Format and seeding== Teams entered the competition at various stages, as follows: * '''First phase''' (one-legged fixtures) ** Preliminary round: the four teams from [[Serie C]] and four [[Serie B]] teams started the tournament ** First round: the four winners were joined by the remaining 16 [[Serie B]] teams, and 12 teams from [[Serie A]] ** Second round: the 16 winners faced each other * '''Second phase''' ** Round of 16 (one-legged): the eight winners were joined by [[Serie A]] clubs, seeded 1–8 (last year winners [[Bologna FC 1909|Bologna]] and clubs ranked 1–7 in the [[2024–25 Serie A]]) ** Quarter-finals (one-legged): the eight winners faced each other ** Semi-finals (two-legged): the four winners faced each other ** Final (one-legged): the two winners faced each other ==Round dates== {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center; font-size: 100%; width: 800px;" ! width=11% | Phase ! width=15% | Round ! width=10% | Clubs remaining ! width=10% | Clubs involved ! width=10% | From previous round ! width=10% | Entries in this round ! width=16% | First leg ! width=16% | Second leg |- | rowspan=3 align=center | First stage | align="center" | Preliminary round | align=center | 44 | align=center | 8 | align=center | none | align=center | 8 | colspan=2 align=center | 9–10 August 2025 |- | align=center | First round | align=center | 40 | align=center | 32 | align=center | 4 | align=center | 28 | colspan=2 align=center | 15–18 August 2025 |- | align=center | Second round | align=center | 24 | align=center | 16 | align=center | 16 | align=center | none | colspan=2 align=center | 23–25 September 2025 |- | rowspan=4 align=center | Second stage | align=center | Round of 16 | align=center | 16 | align=center | 16 | align=center | 8 | align=center | 8 | colspan=2 align=center | 2–4 December 2025
